presupuesto.name: Construction Budget
presupuesto.description:
In metroKUBIKO you can create construction budgets quickly, accurately and collaboratively. The platform offers you three flexible ways to do it:

1. From scratch: Build your budget step by step by creating chapters, subchapters, activities, basic items, inputs and unit price analyses directly on the project sheet.

2. Importing from Excel: If you already have your budget in spreadsheets, you can easily import it, including inputs and unit price analyses. You just need to ask Laura, our virtual assistant, for help and she will guide you step by step.

3. Using the metroKUBIKO database: Access a library of unit price analyses that you can drag directly into your project budget and customize according to your needs.

Additionally, you can quote input prices online. With a single click, metroKUBIKO uses artificial intelligence to search for suppliers near your construction site location, automatically showing you updated prices and purchase links. Forget about making three quotes per product: the platform will deliver up to 10 real quotes in seconds.

With Laura's support, our virtual assistant, you will be able to streamline, automate and optimize the preparation of budgets for your construction projects.

programacion.name: Construction Scheduling
programacion.description:
The metroKUBIKO platform provides you with a powerful construction scheduling tool based on a fully online Gantt chart. This functionality allows you to visualize the project activity list, each with its start and end date, automatically generating duration bars on the calendar. Duration can be calculated automatically from the performance of unit price analyses associated with each activity.

Additionally, you can establish dependency relationships between activities, such as start-finish, finish-start, start-start, among others, allowing you to dynamically build the project's critical path.

From the Gantt chart, the platform also automatically generates a cash flow, in which you can visualize both the costs associated with each activity in a given period, as well as the list of required inputs, which will facilitate advance planning of your purchases.

As with all metroKUBIKO tools, multiple collaborators can work simultaneously on construction scheduling, which speeds up processes and significantly improves team efficiency.

inventarios.name: Inventory Management
inventarios.description:
With metroKUBIKO you can comprehensively control construction input inventories, as well as all purchase and material consumption management in your projects. The platform offers tools for each stage of the process: from input requests to recording their consumption on site. Additionally, you will have real-time reports —such as Stock and Kardex— for all projects you are working on, and automatic alerts when budgeted quantities are exceeded or additional inputs are requested.

Warehouse Module Tools

REQUISITIONS
Resident engineers can easily register material requests needed for a specific period (for example, the following week). These requisitions are processed by the purchasing department, which automatically generates corresponding purchase orders for suppliers.

PURCHASE ORDERS
Allows the purchasing department to manage input orders to suppliers. These orders can be created manually or from requisitions. Each generated order activates alerts about material reception, helping to prevent delays on site.

WAREHOUSE ENTRIES
Warehouse keepers can digitally register the arrival of inputs to the site, automatically from purchase orders. This tool simplifies the process, avoids reprocessing and does not require advanced software knowledge, as the platform is intuitive. Registration increases project stock.

WAREHOUSE EXITS
Allows controlling material consumption by assigning them to specific activities where they will be used. The warehouse keeper, together with the resident engineer, records exits for contractors or workers, automatically unloading inputs from inventory and adding their cost to the corresponding activity.

RETURNS
Facilitates the return of defective or unused materials to suppliers. This process is associated with the purchase invoice and unloads inputs from inventory without generating additional costs for the project.

REIMBURSEMENTS
Allows re-entering into the warehouse materials not consumed by contractors or workers. These reimbursements are associated with the original Warehouse Exit and reduce the cost of the destination activity.

TRANSFERS
With this tool you can transfer materials between warehouses or between different projects. The system automatically performs the exit in the source project and generates the entry in the destination project, keeping the inventory of both locations updated.

Thanks to these tools, you will be able to keep all processes documented and under control, while accessing real-time reports on inventories, consumption by contractor, purchases by supplier, material use by activity, among many other key indicators to make better decisions in your projects.

contratos.name: Piecework Labor Contracts
contratos.description:
The metroKUBIKO platform has a specialized tool for managing labor contracts under the piecework modality, ideal for tracking the execution progress of each project activity.

Each contract is assigned to a specific worker and includes the detailed list of activities they must execute, along with their quantities and prices. Additionally, you can easily configure parameters such as withholdings, indirect costs, taxes and other relevant values.

Being directly linked to the project budget, contracts do not allow assigned engineers to exceed the values defined in unit price analyses (APUs). If a cost overrun is required, it must be previously authorized by a user with a superior role. This ensures rigorous budget control from the contracting stage.

Work Cuts
The tool allows site residents to generate cuts quickly and easily, automatically obtaining all calculations of accumulated amounts, withholdings, advance amortizations and more, without errors or reprocessing.

Contract Minutes
It also includes a contract minutes editor, where you can save your predefined templates and use them easily when preparing each contractor's minutes.

With metroKUBIKO, you maintain financial and contractual control of labor in your project, in a structured, secure and efficient manner.

nomina.name: Payroll Management
nomina.description:
When managing payment of your site personnel under the direct administration method —that is, through a formal payroll that includes days worked, legal withholdings, bonuses, and contributions to health and pension systems—, it is essential to have a tool that simplifies this task without losing detail.

For this purpose, metroKUBIKO offers you a specialized module for creating payroll sheets, where you can register all workers assigned to a specific work front. Each worker has their agreed salary, legal deductions, bonuses and other concepts, all in a clear and structured environment.

However, one of the great challenges of this payment method is associating real labor costs to each project activity. Traditionally, this task is solved with spreadsheets, estimated percentages and manual calculations, which consumes valuable time and opens room for errors.

This is where metroKUBIKO makes the difference.

Thanks to its "Payroll Progress" tool, you can automatically prorate the total payroll cost to each of the executed activities. Simply record the work progress in a period (for example, a fortnight), that is, enter the measurement or physical progress of each item. The system will calculate, based on each activity's incidence, the corresponding labor cost.

This approach not only saves time for technical personnel on site, but also allows you to know in real time how much it costs to execute each activity, with precise and traceable data. This way you can make better decisions, optimize resources and manage with a broader vision of the project.

costos.name: Cost Management and Control
costos.description:
Take total control of your project costs, in real time, with metroKUBIKO

When you are in charge of project management, decisions must be quick, but many times you face the frustration of not having timely information. Questions like:

What is the real progress of an activity?

Am I within budget or do I already have deviations?

Why was a cost overrun generated?

Were incorrect inputs assigned to an activity?

How much money do I need to finish the project?

What inputs or resources are generating higher costs?

How does the budgeted unit price compare to the executed one?

What is the current value of my inventory?

How much should I charge for advances?

These doubts should not take days or weeks to resolve by depending on extensive or poorly consolidated reports.

With metroKUBIKO and its Cost Control tool, you get immediate, clear and reliable answers, without depending on third parties, without waiting and often with just one click.

This not only improves decision-making, but also gives you a complete view of the financial status of your site, allowing you to anticipate deviations, adjust course and optimize project resources.

The tool presents you with five key scenarios to have absolute control of the project:

🔹 1. Initial Budget
It is the baseline with which you start your site: chapters, subchapters, activities, inputs, unit price analyses and indirect costs. Everything you have projected, organized and loaded from the initial planning.

🔹 2. Modified Budget
During execution, conditions change. With this scenario you can update quantities and costs without losing sight of your original budget. Ideal for unforeseen new activities or scope adjustments.

🔹 3. Executed Budget
It is the real reflection of what has happened on site: consumed materials, paid labor, rented equipment and everything recorded by your team. The platform automatically consolidates this information to give you a faithful view of real costs.

🔹 4. Budget to Execute
Automatically calculated as the difference between the modified budget and the executed one. This way you know, at all times, how much money you need to invest to finish the project.

🔹 5. Projected Budget
It is the combination of the executed budget plus what remains to be executed. This scenario anticipates the total cost at which the site will end, allowing you to act in time, correct deviations and optimize results before it is too late.

With metroKUBIKO, you can identify from major expenses —such as installing an elevator— to minimal errors, such as a nail incorrectly assigned to an activity. Nothing goes unnoticed.

The information is there. What matters is having it in time to make decisions. And that is exactly what metroKUBIKO offers you.

ventas.name: Sales Budget - for contractors and builders
ventas.description:
If you build for third parties —whether for the State, a company or a private client— metroKUBIKO puts in your hands a specialized tool to manage contracts under the piecework method that we call SALES BUDGET.

This tool starts from your project's initial cost budget, with its respective unit price analyses (APUs), and allows you to add a specific profitability to each activity, either in monetary value or as a percentage of its cost. This utility is calculated before applying the project's general indirect costs.

The contracting budget includes only the activities you decide to incorporate into the contract, leaving out those that, although they must be executed, do not generate direct billing. Each activity is defined with its unit of measure and work quantity, which makes preparing a billing certificate quick and simple: you just create the new certificate, enter the executed quantity and the platform automatically calculates profitability, progress, accumulated amounts and other key indicators.

Additionally, Sales Budget offers you detailed profitability reports for each activity, comparing what was contracted with actual execution. This way you can know effective profitability, costs by inputs, contracts and payrolls, as well as the total invested to date, including material in stock and pending advances to collect.

With Sales Budget, your contract will always be under control: you will have total visibility, make decisions with precise information and avoid losses due to lack of management.

ia.name: AI Automations
ia.description:
The metroKUBIKO platform incorporates automations driven by artificial intelligence that can reduce your process times by up to 60 days, especially in tasks such as material quoting or automatic budget generation. This allows your company to achieve greater efficiency and productivity in each project.

Main AI automations:

1. Construction material quoting
Once your project budget is finished, with the unit price analysis and complete material list, the quoting process begins. Traditionally, this can involve phone calls, price list requests or web searches, and take up to 60 days. With metroKUBIKO, this process is reduced to less than 20 minutes: automatically quote all your project materials in real time and immediately receive purchase links for each input, streamlining management and decision-making.

2. Automatic budgets with AI
With our Artificial Intelligence agent, you can generate a preliminary budget for your project in minutes. Just enter the basic data of your site —such as area, number of floors, foundation type, construction system— and, if you want greater precision, attach PDF plans. The platform will deliver a complete budget, with activity list, unit price analyses and necessary materials, ready to edit and adjust directly according to your needs.

🤖 Create automatic budget with AI


3. Virtual assistant Laura
If you have files in Excel or PDF, such as construction budgets, purchase invoices or other documents, Laura imports them directly into your project. Additionally, you can request automated reports on budgets, execution, deviations or projections. With this real-time information, you will make more accurate and strategic decisions. Laura also manages scheduled notifications, keeping you always up to date with your project.

In summary, metroKUBIKO, powered by AI, will continue to grow in functions and automations, making the management of your projects easier, more efficient and safer, allowing you to control every detail and minimize the risks of not meeting budget or schedule.

integraciones.name: Integrations
integraciones.description:
Smart integrations that take your automation to the next level

To maximize the automation of your processes, metroKUBIKO incorporates strategic integrations with various platforms, making your favorite tools work in a connected and coordinated way. This continuous digital dialogue allows information to flow automatically between systems, eliminating duplicate tasks and minimizing human errors.

The result is a collaborative and frictionless experience, where your entire team accesses updated data in real time, coordinates activities and makes precise and timely decisions. Thanks to these integrations, the management of your projects becomes smarter, more efficient and smoother, boosting your company's productivity from day one.

1. REST API: the core of connectivity in metroKUBIKO

Our REST API is a powerful and flexible tool, designed to facilitate integration between metroKUBIKO and other technological platforms. Based on standard CRUD verbs (Create, Read, Update, Delete), it allows developers to interact with the platform in a simple, secure and efficient way.

With this API, programmers can write and query data in real time within metroKUBIKO: create projects, record progress, upload budgets or access key information such as site status, costs, resources or schedules.

This bidirectional capability makes metroKUBIKO an open and collaborative ecosystem, capable of integrating with ERPs, cost control systems or other management solutions, enhancing process automation and eliminating repetitive or manual tasks.

🚀 Learn about REST API


2. Integration with Siigo accounting software

Siigo is a cloud-based accounting and administrative platform, aimed at SMEs and accounting professionals, that allows managing accounting, electronic invoicing, payroll, inventories and commercial operations from any device connected to the internet. With more than one million users in Latin America, it offers functionalities such as POS, automated reports, regulatory compliance and continuous training.

If your company uses Siigo as accounting software, metroKUBIKO connects directly through Siigo's REST API, allowing you to consult and record accounting information in real time —for example, material purchases or labor cut certificates—. This way, you ensure synchronized, smooth and reprocessing-free management between your administrative and site systems.

3. Custom integrations: we adapt to your digital ecosystem

At metroKUBIKO we know that each company has a unique digital environment. That's why, if your organization uses other platforms —such as sales CRMs, horizontal property management software or accounting systems other than Siigo—, our technical team can develop integrations tailored to your needs.

We connect metroKUBIKO with the tools you already use, ensuring an automated and secure information flow between systems. This way, you eliminate reprocessing, optimize times and keep all your data —from sales and accounting to site management— synchronized and updated in real time.

meta.title: About Us · Metrokubiko
meta.description: Find more information about our history, values, mission and more. We are a group of people who share the same values.

mission.paragraph1: metroKUBIKO is a web platform, created from Colombia for the digital transformation of the construction industry throughout the Latin American continent. It has been developed since 2013 by a multidisciplinary team of professionals, including architects, civil engineers, computer engineers, teachers, builders, among others, some with more than 30 years of experience in construction.​
mission.paragraph2: We have seen that construction, in our countries, is a quite traditional sector regarding the use of information technologies, however, after the confinement, it became evident that companies would need their executives to work from home or from any other place different from the construction site and also that everyone would feed information into the same project.
mission.paragraph3: This would avoid reprocessing, delays in information and would allow project control at all times and from any device connected to the internet. Thus, company managers and decision makers would obtain real-time reports of their project, not only in general but in each of their particular activities.​
mission.paragraph4: metroKUBIKO is the answer to that need…

Colombia PotencIA Digital Project, driven by the Ministry of Information and Communications Technologies (MinTIC), is a comprehensive strategy with an investment of $2 trillion (2023–2026) designed to consolidate and accelerate innovation ecosystems and digital transformation in all regions of the country. Through the articulation of Government, companies, entrepreneurs, investors, academia and communities, PotencIA Digital promotes permanent connectivity, development of technical capabilities, creation of digital transformation indices and adoption of artificial intelligence as a growth engine.

Additionally, it implements 24/7 digital centers, training routes for one million people in ICT skills and dynamic governance models to generate high-impact regional and global solutions.
